meta.title: Crumb & Kiln | Sourdough bakery on Chatsworth Road, Clapton
meta.description: Small sourdough bakery in Clapton. Sourdough loaves, cardamom buns, seasonal tarts and birthday cakes to order. Open Wednesday to Sunday, baking from 5am.

rationale: A bakery that sells out by 1pm needs a page that says what is on the counter, when the door opens and how to order a cake, so the order follows that: hero, today's bake, cakes, the bakers, the visit. The soft clay direction is a sage background with blush panels and a terracotta accent, rounded corners, and a soft serif (Fraunces). A hand-drawn loaf, bun and tart, a circled 5am and a handwritten note from Ana and Joe make it feel like a small neighbourhood shop, not a template.

props.headline: Fresh sourdough from Chatsworth Road, until it's gone.
props.sub: Ana and Joe bake sourdough loaves, cardamom buns and seasonal tarts from 5am, Wednesday to Sunday. Most days we have sold out by 1pm.

featured.description: The loaves are what we are known for. They come out of the oven first thing in the morning and they are the first thing to go. Today's list goes on the board by the door.

props.caption: Loaf, bun, tart: the three things to look for on the counter.

pairs.ask: I'd like a birthday cake. Where do I start?
pairs.answer: Send us the date you need it, roughly how many people it should feed and any allergies. Ana or Joe will reply with what we can do.
As early as you can. We bake bread every morning from 5am, so cake orders fit in around the loaves.
Collect it from the bakery on Chatsworth Road, Wednesday to Sunday.

props.text: If you're after a loaf, come before lunch. We usually sell out by 1pm and we hate having to say no.

props.title: Ana and Joe
props.text: There are two of us. We start at 5am, shape and bake through the morning, then open the door on Chatsworth Road, Wednesday to Sunday. By 1pm the shelves are usually empty, and the next day we start again. Sourdough, cardamom buns, tarts for whatever fruit is in season, and birthday cakes when you ask us nicely.

photo.subject: Ana and Joe together behind the counter or at the bench in aprons, covered in a little flour, looking relaxed, with shelves of loaves behind them
